description: Find Blue Top on Automation Exercise, add it to the cart, and stop before checkout or payment.

pages.name: consent
pages.text_marker: This site asks for consent to use your data

procedures.description: When the consent dialog covers a page, decline tracking via Manage options, then resume the interrupted shop procedure.

steps.goal: The privacy dialog covers the page. If it offers Reject or Do not consent, choose that; otherwise click Manage options and then Confirm choices without enabling any consent toggles. Never click Consent or Accept all. Stop when the privacy dialog is gone.

procedures.description: From the Products listing: search for the named product before any offer is available.

steps.goal: Find the Search Product field, enter {product}, and submit the search button. Stop on SEARCHED PRODUCTS results.

procedures.description: Only after SEARCHED PRODUCTS results appear: open the matching product detail.

steps.goal: Click the View Product link beneath the {product} card on SEARCHED PRODUCTS, not the search icon or Add to cart. If View Product is absent from the current snapshot, scroll down to reveal it before clicking. Stop on the product detail page.

procedures.description: Add the product to the cart; confirm the Added! dialog.

steps.goal: Add this product to the cart.

procedures.description: Dismiss an optional extra-offer popup, not the successful Added! confirmation.

steps.goal: Dismiss the optional extra-offer popup, if shown.

procedures.description: Navigate to the cart and stop before payment.

steps.goal: Follow View Cart and stop before checkout/payment; verify {product} appears in the cart.

procedures.description: Ask the operator to handle login only if an account is required; not needed to reach cart in this measured flow.

steps.goal: Pause and ask the human to sign in; do not enter credentials.

notes: A demo shop. A consent dialog may cover the page first: decline through Manage options. Products lists every item; its search box (Search Product) filters by name. The left sidebar has Category and Brands (Polo, H&M, ...); a brand link lists that brand's products. A product's 'View Product' opens its details with the price as 'Rs. N'. Never check out or pay.
